sentences.text: The Independent Commission Against Corruption prepared this organisational questionnaire to profile NSW public sector functions, corruption risks and prevention practices.
sentences.support:
conducting research to 
develop a profile of the functions, corruption risks and corruption prevention strategies 
within the NSW public sector.

sentences.text: It asks organisations to rate potential corruption risks and indicate whether those risks are managed adequately or need more attention.
sentences.support:

sentences.text: It also asks about designated responsibility for prevention, risk management processes and employee training on codes of conduct.
sentences.support:

notes: This source is a blank organisational survey instrument, not a results report. It has no executive summary, findings or recommendations.
